sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: The catalogue's Calluna entry is Calluna vulgaris, common heather. This evergreen subshrub is usually about 20–60 cm tall and spreads to roughly 75 cm. Tiny scale-like leaves line the stems; pink, purple or white flowers appear on summer spikes. It is characteristic of acidic heathland.

sections.title: Uses and image
sections.text: Flowers and young shoots have traditional uses in teas and beer or ale; the flowers also provide heather honey. The plate's low woody habit, scale-like leaves and flower spikes are consistent with the species.
